productiveContract.objectIdUsage: not found in the audited productive command producer or immediate consumers
productiveContract.regionIdUsage: emitted by flattenToCommands; used by CE01 validation and route/detail grouping
productiveContract.colorUsage: emitted when object context supplies it; used for thread blocks and display; consumers fall back when absent
productiveContract.stitchTypeUsage: optional producer context used by contour/detail guards and thread-block reporting
productiveContract.metadataUsage: no generic metadata object belongs to the common flattenToCommands command core
fieldsAddedLater: trim and jump commands can be synthesized by CE01 sanitization
colorChange commands can be restored by direct DST export
end is guaranteed by validation/auto-fix or export

sequenceSemantics.firstProductivePoint: flattenToCommands normally sequences from the current needle position and may add jump/trim; P1.F2 does not perform that decision
sequenceSemantics.adapterFirstCommand: destination of P1.F1 command 0, never startAnchorMm
sequenceSemantics.lastProductivePoint: destination of the final P1.F1 command
sequenceSemantics.jump: productive control op between spans/objects; forbidden in the isolated adapter
sequenceSemantics.trim: productive control op before sufficiently long travel; forbidden in the isolated adapter
sequenceSemantics.end: single trailing design terminator added by productive flow; forbidden in the isolated adapter
sequenceSemantics.colorChange: productive stop between thread-color blocks; forbidden in the isolated adapter
sequenceSemantics.tieInTieOff: point patterns are inserted by productive stitch generators, not represented as distinct common command types; P1.F2 adds none
sequenceSemantics.underlay: inserted at object-stitch generation for fill/satin; P1.F2 adds none

sanitization.stage: after flattenToCommands and before encoding inside buildFinalCommands
sanitization.duplicateRemoval: may remove stitch commands below 0.05 mm
sanitization.microMerge: may remove eligible stitches below 0.8 mm
sanitization.longSplit: may add stitch destinations above 8 mm
sanitization.jumpOptimization: may collapse/re-split jumps and insert trims
sanitization.fieldRemoval: existing stitch objects are copied with spread syntax; no named stitch field is stripped

encoderBoundary.dstDirectExportConversion: Math.round(x*10), Math.round(y*10), then relative 0.1 mm deltas
encoderBoundary.dstEncoderInput: absolute points already expressed in 0.1 mm units
encoderBoundary.dsbEncoderInput: absolute points already expressed in 0.1 mm units
encoderBoundary.reasonNotTargeted: P1.F2 must preserve full-precision millimeters and cannot quantize

adapterProfile.rationale: type/x/y are mandatory for all immediate consumers; regionId is authoritative in P1.F1 and is a real productive contextual field

excludedFields.color: P1.F1 has no authoritative thread color
excludedFields.stitchType: not required by consumers and would imply an integration decision
excludedFields.source: productive provenance literal would be fabricated
excludedFields.layerType: P1.F1 has no authoritative productive layer
excludedFields.objectId: not part of the audited command contract
excludedFields.metadata: generic metadata is not part of the common command core
